review_comment: The validateLink function performs protocol validation on the raw URL string before entity decoding, allowing encoded colons (e.g., 'javascript%3a') to bypass the blocklist. This is an improper input validation flaw because the check does not operate on the canonical form of the input. To remediate, ensure URL validation occurs after full decoding, for example by calling `normalizeLinkText` or applying `mdurl.decode` before the protocol check in `validateLink`.
